description: Tolerance policy of `perf.py refcheck` (PROTECTED). For every value with exact value x: e_ref = |v_ref - x|, e_new = |v_new - x|, unit = 2^-52 * magnitude * (sumAbsCoeffs + sqrt(sumGP)) (round-off unit of the combination; reassociation across thread counts moved results by at most 1.54 units in the setup session), noise = noise_units * unit. OK if e_new <= ok_ratio * e_ref + noise; WARN if e_new <= fail_ratio * e_ref + noise (error grew slightly: must be stated and justified in the summary, the owner decides); FAIL otherwise. 'ints' (structure: number of tensor grids, number of grid points, order-independent hash of the (multi-index, coefficient) pairs, closure size/hash) must match exactly (a change is a functional change); 'floats' (node checksum) up to float_rel_tol; 'info' (number of source function evaluations) changes are reported as INFO. Owner requirement: errors stay in the same order of magnitude, may grow slightly, but should generally not. Per-case overrides: {"<case>": {"ok_ratio": .., "fail_ratio": .., "noise_units": ..}} (only with the owner's consent).
